name: Task router — envelope selection for gauntlet dispatch
description: Routes a task to a seat ENVELOPE before any gauntlet fires: tier (junior/senior/architect), borrowed seat (live cartridge check, rotated preference glm-geoff → deepseek-dorian → qwen-1 → kimi-1), reviewer runtime, gate policy. Deterministic v1 — the cognitive-router (:3068) model branch is probed and reported, not spent. Params: task (REQUIRED — its leading word can force architect tier: design/decompose/architect/spec), confine? (comma paths, no spaces), gateCommand?, agent (notify target). Returns the envelope + reason + warnings via notify; read the run record for the full object. Consumed by the judge loop / dispatcher BEFORE firing build-gauntlet; the envelope's fields ARE build-gauntlet's params.

meta.description: Deterministic envelope selection; fails loud with no available seat.
Deliver the envelope to the dispatching agent.
